description: DBEngine.CompactDatabase of each complex fixture (multi-value text, the eight kinds, attachments, calculated fields, append-only history) twice: with no options and with DstLocale dbLangGeneral and dbVersion40 (an ACCDB-to-Jet4 request carrying complex, calculated or history features). Each output that exists is reopened read-only and its catalog, groups, rows and ColumnHistory are read; attachments are exported from the compacted file; DBEngine.Errors is read after each compaction.
